title: NOAA NCEI climate data (Access Data Service, Climate Data Online)
agency: National Centers for Environmental Information, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
questions: daily high and low temperatures in a city last year
monthly precipitation at a station since 2000
how this year's temperature compares with the 1991-2020 normal
annual snowfall trend at a station

key_only: Climate Data Online v2 endpoints (cdo_*): station and location search by FIPS code, data for a whole state or county, dataset and data-type lists

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser (keyless Access Data Service; change format=json to format=csv for a spreadsheet) and upload the files. A station's whole record is one CSV: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/data/daily-summaries/access/<STATION>.csv (also global-summary-of-the-month/access/ and global-summary-of-the-year/access/). Station finder: https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/cdo-web/ (Search Tool) or https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/search/data-search/daily-summaries.

cache.why: Recent days are revised as quality control runs; data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: NOAA NCEI data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); NCEI asks that the data source be cited (GHCN-Daily: Menne et al., NOAA NCEI).

citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, {dataset}, www.ncei.noaa.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which station? A city has several (airport vs downtown); name the station id used, e.g. USW00094728 Central Park.
Daily, monthly or annual values, and which measure (TMAX, TMIN, TAVG, PRCP, SNOW)?
Compare with which normal? Default: U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020.
